apps.versionDescription:
# Restring Helper — Full Changelog

---

## New Features
- **Multi-Racket Orders** — You can now process customers dropping off 2+ rackets in one go. A new + Add Another Racket button has been added to the bottom of the New Order screen.
- **Smart Cloning** — Tapping + Add Another Racket automatically duplicates the stringing and tension specifications from the previous racket. If they want identical string jobs, you don't have to type it twice.
- **Visual Grouping Hints** — Rackets belonging to a multi-racket drop-off automatically get a tiny orange note injected under their details on the dashboard (e.g., Racket 1 of 3) so you instantly know they belong together.
- **New Bulk Selection Workflow** — The persistent "Edit" button at the top of the dashboard has been completely removed for a cleaner UI. To bulk delete orders, you now Long Press any order and tap Select.

---

## Enhancements & Quality of Life
- **Instant Dashboard Updates** — Fixed the issue where updating an order's details required you to manually pull-to-refresh the dashboard to see the changes. Edits now reflect instantly the moment you hit save.
- **Auto-Exit Edit Mode** — After bulk deleting a batch of orders, the dashboard will now automatically exit selection mode so you don't have to manually cancel out of it.
- **SMS Flexibility** — Multi-rackets are cloned as independent orders, giving you manual control over the SMS. You can use the "Done (No SMS)" swipe action on the first two rackets, and use the standard "Done + SMS" on the final one so the customer only gets 1 text.

---

## Bug Fixes
- **Infinite Loading Loop Fixed** — Resolved a thread issue that caused the dashboard to get stuck showing an infinite loading circle after a bulk delete operation.
- **Dark Mode Toggle Bug Fixed** — Fixed a deep-rooted SwiftUI rendering issue where switching the app's appearance (Light/Dark/System) in the settings wouldn't apply correctly or would glitch out across different screens.
